segments.name: Securities brokerage
segments.description: Provides securities brokerage, underwriting, placement, asset management and margin financing services in Hong Kong to clients.
segments.evidence: Based on management's assessment, the Group determines that it has only one operating segment and therefore one reportable segment as defined by ASC 280.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay fixed due diligence service fees, and other financial service providers pay introducing and referral fees for customers introduced to them.
revenueModel.evidence: We charge an introducing and referral income structured as a fixed lump sum or monthly fee basis.
